scope: Independent visual and task-clarity assessment of provided synthetic Chromium pixels only. Not deployed authentication, real family data, physical iPad/Safari, genuine YouTube, measured contrast/touch size, keyboard behavior or end-to-end correctness.
independence: No peer reports, votes, repair history, Builder rationale, agent status or peer messages read before verdict freeze. No source edits, new app captures, commits, deployment or subagents.

nonblockingSuggestions.finding: Topic requests require manually returning to mark fulfillment after adding a video; explicit instructions make current flow understandable, but this adds Parent bookkeeping.
nonblockingSuggestions.suggestion: Later provide a linked return-to-request/fulfill step after approval.

nonblockingSuggestions.finding: Footer explains session time as a wall-clock access deadline and says it does not reconstruct YouTube watch time. Accurate-looking distinction is harder to parse than surrounding family language.
nonblockingSuggestions.suggestion: Use plain language such as Time keeps counting when a video is paused; retain the precise distinction in secondary help.

nonblockingSuggestions.finding: The single collection and generous vertical gaps push most grid actions below the first landscape fold; content remains reachable in inspected lower regions.
nonblockingSuggestions.suggestion: Consider slightly tighter section spacing when only one collection exists, while preserving child-size controls.
